tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save information to long-term memory. Automatically detects duplicates, categorizes the content, and connects it to related memories. Use this to store facts, decisions, or anything worth remembering.

context_ids.description: IDs of related memories to link to

visibility.description: Who can see this: 'private' (only you), 'shared' (all agents), 'thread' (same conversation)

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search your memories by meaning, not just keywords. Returns the most relevant memories ranked by relevance, importance, and recency.

context_ids.description: IDs of related memories to boost in results

conversation_thread.description: Thread ID for scoping results to a conversation

explain.description: If true, return detailed score breakdown for each result (vector similarity, ACT-R activation, FSRS retrievability, salience)

tools.name: associate
tools.description: Create a link between two memories. Links improve search: when one memory is found, linked memories are boosted in results. Link types: temporal, causal, semantic, affective, contextual, contradicts, supports, derived_from, part_of.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Get a single memory by ID with all its metadata, tags, and concepts.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory. Removes it from both search and the link graph.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update a memory's content, tags, importance, or visibility. Changing content will update its search index automatically.

visibility.description: Who can see this: 'private' (only you), 'shared' (all agents), 'thread' (same conversation)

tools.name: share_memory
tools.description: Change who can see a memory. Options: 'private' (only the owner), 'shared' (all agents), 'thread' (agents in the same conversation). Only the memory owner can change this.

tools.name: episode_start
tools.description: Start recording a sequence of related events as an episode. Memories added as steps will be linked in order.

tools.name: episode_add_step
tools.description: Add a memory as the next step in an episode. Steps are linked in sequence automatically.

role.description: Role of this step in the episode

tools.name: episode_end
tools.description: Finish recording an episode. Optionally add a summary and overall tone.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List recent episodes with their title, step count, tone, and creation time.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get full details of an episode including all its steps.

tools.name: get_episode_memories
tools.description: Get all memories in an episode, in order.

tools.name: store_intention
tools.description: Save a TODO or reminder for future action. The system will surface it when relevant.

tools.name: list_intentions
tools.description: List pending TODOs and reminders that have not been resolved.

tools.name: resolve_intention
tools.description: Mark a TODO or reminder as done.

memory_id.description: Memory ID of the intention to resolve

tools.name: session_save
tools.description: Save a summary of the current session so your future self can pick up where you left off. Include key discoveries, unfinished tasks, and orientation notes.

tools.name: session_recall
tools.description: Retrieve notes from previous sessions for orientation. Useful at the start of a new session to remember where you left off.

lookback_hours.description: How far back to search (default: 168 = 1 week)

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent in the memory system. Each agent gets its own memory space with configurable sharing.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all registered agents in the memory system.

tools.name: memory_health
tools.description: Get a health report for the memory system: total memories, links, episodes, and breakdowns by type and layer.

tools.name: memory_graph_stats
tools.description: Get detailed statistics about the memory graph: node counts, link counts by type, and graph structure metrics.

tools.name: memory_neighbors
tools.description: Get memories directly linked to a given memory, sorted by link strength.

tools.name: cortex_stats
tools.description: Get comprehensive system statistics as raw JSON.

tools.name: dream_run
tools.description: Run an offline memory maintenance cycle. Consolidates recent episodes, extracts patterns, prunes low-value memories, and discovers new connections. Uses LLM calls.

max_llm_calls.description: Max LLM calls for this cycle (default: 20)

tools.name: dream_status
tools.description: Get the status and last report from the memory maintenance cycle.

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: Find the shortest chain of links between two memories.

tools.name: common_neighbors
tools.description: Find memories that are linked to both memory A and memory B.

tools.name: create_schema
tools.description: Create a general pattern or principle derived from multiple memories. Useful for capturing recurring themes or lessons learned.

content.description: The pattern or principle to record

source_ids.description: IDs of the memories this pattern is derived from

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List all stored patterns and principles.

tools.name: find_matching_schemas
tools.description: Find patterns and principles matching given tags or concepts.

tools.name: get_schema_sources
tools.description: Get the original memories that a pattern or principle was derived from.

tools.name: store_procedure
tools.description: Store a workflow, strategy, or how-to guide. These are recalled when you need instructions for a task.

derived_from.description: IDs of memories this procedure is derived from

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: List all stored workflows, strategies, and how-to guides.

tools.name: find_relevant_procedures
tools.description: Find workflows and how-to guides matching given tags or concepts.

tools.name: record_procedure_outcome
tools.description: Record whether a procedure worked or failed. This improves future procedure recommendations.

tools.name: emotional_summary
tools.description: Get a breakdown of memories by emotional tone (positive, negative, neutral, mixed).

tools.name: ingest_file
tools.description: Read a file and store its contents as searchable memories. Supports text, markdown, JSON, images (PNG/JPG/WebP), PDFs, HTML, and CSV. Large files are automatically split into sections. Images get captions, OCR text, and optional vision embeddings.

tags.description: Tags to apply to all imported memories

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Generate a text description of an image file without storing it in memory. Uses local vision model (Ollama) or filename fallback.

image_path.description: Absolute path to the image file

tools.name: search_vision
tools.description: Search image memories by text description or find similar images. Requires vision extras installed.

image_path.description: Path to an image to use as query (image-to-image search)

query_text.description: Text query to search image memories

tools.name: list_deleted
tools.description: List soft-deleted memories that can be restored.

tools.name: restore_memory
tools.description: Undelete a soft-deleted memory and re-add it to the vector index.

tools.name: purge_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory, bypassing the trash can.

tools.name: purge_all_deleted
tools.description: Hard-delete all soft-deleted memories older than N days.

agent_id.description: Only purge this agent's deleted memories

tools.name: get_memory_versions
tools.description: Get version history for a memory. Each content change creates a snapshot.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Restore a memory to a previous version snapshot.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags with usage counts.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag across all memories.

tools.name: merge_tags
tools.description: Merge multiple tags into one.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from all memories.

tools.name: bulk_delete
tools.description: Delete multiple memories at once. Defaults to soft delete.

tools.name: export_memories
tools.description: Export memories to JSON or Markdown.

memory_ids.description: Specific memory IDs (omit for all visible)

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads with memory counts.

tools.name: get_thread_memories
tools.description: Get all memories in a conversation thread.

tools.name: prune_thread
tools.description: Soft-delete all memories in a conversation thread.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to another agent. Bypasses gating — messages are always delivered. Auto-tags with from/to and links replies. Use to='all' for broadcast.

in_reply_to.description: Memory ID of message being replied to (creates a supports link)

to.description: Recipient agent ID (e.g. 'CLAUDE-HAILO'), or 'all' for broadcast

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: Check for messages from other agents addressed to you. Returns newest first.

from_agent.description: Only show messages from this agent

since.description: Only messages after this ISO timestamp (e.g. '2026-02-08T00:00:00')

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Save information to memory (alias for 'remember').

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search memories (alias for 'recall').

tools.name: cognitive_bootstrap
tools.description: Assemble a dynamic cognitive prompt block from Cerebro Cognitive Bootstrap System (CCBS) modules. Analyzes your query to load relevant cognitive priming modules (soul manifest, core identity, technical, analysis, creative, etc.) within a token budget.

agent_id.description: Agent ID for module visibility filtering

mode.description: Token budget tier: minimal (~900), standard (~1600), full (~4200). Auto-detected if omitted.

query.description: Your intent or question — drives module auto-selection

tools.name: check_near_duplicates
tools.description: Check if content would be a near-duplicate of existing memories. Returns existing memories with similarity scores above the threshold. Useful for deduplication previews before ingestion.

threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0). Higher = stricter. Default: 0.95

tools.name: activation_heatmap
tools.description: Get activation data for all memories (age, activation, retrievability, layer, salience). Suitable for scatter-plot visualization of memory health.

tools.name: activation_at_risk
tools.description: Get memories that are fading — low activation, low retrievability, or not accessed recently. These memories may need review or revival.

hours.description: Hours since last access to be considered 'at risk'. Default: 24

tools.name: activation_curve
tools.description: Get the projected ACT-R decay curve for a specific memory over N days.

tools.name: query_audit
tools.description: Query the audit log with optional filters (event type, actor, target). Returns timestamped records of memory mutations.

actor.description: Filter by agent ID who performed the action

event_type.description: Filter by event type (e.g. memory_deleted, content_edited, visibility_changed)

tools.name: audit_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of audit events grouped by type with counts.
